problem_type: fork capabilities bypassing upstream catalog and task invariants
symptom: Replaying the Nomi-H3 snapshot directly onto Nomi v0.21 would create parallel vendor seeds, incomplete generated archetype projections, and provider-task recovery paths that disagreed with the upstream capability core.
direct_cause: The fork was built from v0.20.1 while upstream subsequently centralized builtin vendor seeds, archetype generation, task recovery, skill storage, and Codex model adapters behind new contracts.
class_root: Fork-owned H3 and Codex capabilities had to be projected through the current upstream owners instead of preserving their former direct-write and duplicate-registry seams.
affected_population: Nomi-H3 projects using AutoDL.art MiniMax H3 generation or task recovery
Users selecting Codex as the text brain or importing director skills
Existing projects loading generated archetype identifiers, modes, and wire defaults after the v0.21 migration
entry_points: Builtin catalog seeding and generated archetype projection
AutoDL.art H3 create and resume-only task flows
Codex CLI text and image model adapters
Provider task result query and recovery
internal_only_reason: This integration preserves the already captured and tested Nomi-H3 provider contracts while moving them through Nomi v0.21's internal owners; it does not infer or change any provider endpoint, field, authentication method, or model capability.
invariants: AutoDL.art is declared once in BUILTIN_VENDOR_SEEDS and every seed consumer derives from that owner.
Generated archetype files are regenerated from their source descriptors and pass the upstream equality gates.
resume_only can only query a persisted provider task and can never silently submit a new paid generation.
Codex remains a local text/image adapter and does not pass through vendor API-key connection construction.
Imported director skills are normalized and stored by the shared skill store rather than written through a second path.

recurrence.reason: Any later H3 or Codex capability that writes a second vendor seed, mapping, or task recovery path would recreate the parallel-registry seam.
same_class_scan: Searched BUILTIN_VENDOR_SEEDS, applyBuiltinSeeds, generated archetype files, resume_only, and Codex adapters.
Confirmed AutoDL.art and Codex local go through the v0.21 catalog/task owners rather than a fork-only registry.

prevention.strategy: Project fork H3/Codex capabilities through the current catalog, archetype generation, and task-recovery owners.

migration: No user project schema bump. Existing H3 catalog rows and provider task identifiers are normalized through the v0.21 catalog/task owners; generated archetype projections are rebuilt from source descriptors.
residual_risks: AutoDL.art provider behavior can still change independently; future endpoint or model changes require a fresh official-document check and trial capture.
Old local Git refs may still retain the pre-redaction sample-response blob, so those refs must not be pushed and any real credential matching the sample identifiers should be rotated.
